name: Queen's Blade Re:Build
storyline:
Queen's Blade. A grand tournament held to determine the queen of the continent.

Since the founding of the kingdom, tradition has decreed that the strongest woman shall rule this land.

Those who enter the Queen`s Blade are known as beautiful warriors.
They stake their lives and their pride on an endless series of battles.

And now, another beautiful warrior sets out on her journey.

Who will emerge victorious? They won' t know that unless they fight!
summary: A roguelite deckbuilder featuring strong, beautiful female warriors. We fused real time card games and roguelite together to make the exciting single player deckbuilder. Discover new cards and item, Craft a strong deck. Break your rival of all their armor and defeat them with a finishing move!
